class.name: GeometryEditorInspectorBase
class.brief_description: Shared EditorInspectorPlugin base class for Geometry, Spline, and Tile resources.
class.description: Injects a compact 'Open in GeometryComposer' launcher bar into the Inspector so heavy 2D canvases stay in the Tier 2 workspace by default. Set [member embed_full_control_in_inspector] to [code]true[/code] if you explicitly want inline Inspector embedding.

members.member: Optional root control used when hosting inspector-launched windows.
When [code]true[/code], hides raw vertex/site/grid arrays managed by custom geometry controls.
When [code]false[/code] (default), shows only the thin GeometryComposer launcher bar in the Inspector instead of embedding a full 2D canvas inline.
